tools.name: jig_validate_json
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether some JSON matches a JSON Schema, or when JSON from a model reply, structured output, tool call, API response or file has to be checked against its schema before it is used or stored (signals: "validate this JSON", "does this match the schema", "which field is wrong", "

tools.name: jig_check_schema
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a JSON Schema is valid, or whether it will work with OpenAI Structured Outputs or function calling with strict: true, Claude structured outputs or strict tool use, or Gemini structured output (response_json_schema), or is writing a tool or function schema, an MCP input

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jig_validate_json, jig_check_schema · Private data: jig_validate_json · Public sink: jig_validate_json.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jig_validate_json, jig_check_schema · Private data: jig_validate_json · Public sink: jig_validate_json

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
